name: Join-entry record normal form

name: Join existence and obstruction status calculus
nonclaim: The status classifier is total only over the declared finite evidence family and is not a universal classification of every possible theory interaction.

name: Strict join certificate and anti-product witness
nonclaim: Strictness remains separate from objecthood and directionality; anti-product evidence alone supplies neither.

name: Source-independence gate
nonclaim: Source independence is required only for independence-sensitive credit and is not equated with behavioral novelty or causal independence.

name: Join budget and payment ledger
nonclaim: The typed ledger and finite capacity theorem do not identify a universal scalar currency or a domain-independent minimum cost.

name: Peer contact and transport without join
nonclaim: Certified transport can make content available to a peer without forming a composite or strict joint theory.

name: Access/join residual and obstruction-dissolution ledger
nonclaim: Residual bookkeeping is scoped to declared ledgers and does not assert that all obstructions are additive or monotonically removed by joining.

name: Categorical reduction decision
nonclaim: No unconditional product, pullback, or pushout representation is claimed; only explicitly checked special cases receive categorical credit.

name: Parent refinement, retention, and join descent
nonclaim: Parent refinement is not monotone for join evidence; preserving, strengthening, weakening, and destroying cases remain distinct.

name: Contact-degree conservation decision
nonclaim: No universal conserved contact degree is named. The tested natural bookkeeping quantities all have lawful nonconservation controls.

name: Coverage-qualified certified non-interaction
nonclaim: Certified non-interaction excludes contact only inside the exact declared family, detector, budget, and horizon; outside-family channels remain explicit escapes.

name: No-free-join and self-bootstrap no-go family
nonclaim: The five no-go fronts are separate scoped results, not one universal impossibility theorem.

name: Join-created obstruction and needle law
nonclaim: A join-created needle requires an active sourced cross-term; relabeling alone does not count as a new obstruction.
